description: This file defines the Processor class responsible for handling various extension points and manipulations within the Daux documentation generator, including tree manipulation, environment extension, and addition of custom generators and content types.
external_methods: League/CommonMark	hemethod(Single example, not all methods clarified in the file)

classes.name: Processor
classes.description: Handles extension points and customization hooks for the Daux documentation system, including tree manipulation, environment extension, and registration of custom generators and content types.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Processor with dependencies: Daux, OutputInterface, and width parameter.

methods.name: manipulateTree
methods.description: Hook to transform or modify the documentation tree structure represented by the Root object.

methods.name: extendCommonMarkEnvironment
methods.description: Hook to extend or modify the Markdown environment used during rendering.

methods.name: addGenerators
methods.description: Allows adding custom generators for different output formats; returns an array mapping format names to generator classes.

methods.name: addContentType
methods.description: Allows adding or replacing content types used during documentation generation; returns an array of ContentType instances.
